cohort: Pregnant women with pre-existing renal conditions who attended a joint obstetric and renal clinic between 2005 and 2021
finding: Pregnant women with lupus nephritis, IgA nephropathy, and APKD experienced a higher incidence of adverse pregnancy outcomes compared to the general pregnant population, supporting the value of specialized renal/obstetric clinics.
mod_finding: This study, examining pregnancy outcomes in patients with chronic kidney disease, found a higher incidence of cesarean sections in patients with IgA nephropathy.
